meaning: the ability to make good judgements based on experience and knowledge
example: I often turn to my grandmother's wisdom when I have a difficult decision to make.

meaning: while considering the heavy rains of the monsoon season when planning or designing something
example: Farmers in our area plant their crops with the monsoon in mind, choosing rice that tolerates flooding.

meaning: to become quieter and avoid spending time with other people

meaning: possible to achieve or obtain

meaning: clever and funny in the way you use words

meaning: clever or funny use of words, especially words with more than one meaning

meaning: so good or useful that it fully justifies the money you paid

meaning: so useful or valuable that it is almost impossible to do without

meaning: useful or valuable enough to justify the time, money or effort
example: Volunteering at the local school was a worthwhile way to spend my weekends last year.

meaning: deserving respect, support or effort
example: Cleaning up our local riverbank is a worthy cause that everyone in the town can support.

meaning: to include something as a natural, closely connected part of something else
example: Religious festivals are deeply woven into the rhythm of daily life in Bangladesh.

meaning: information kept in writing so that it can be checked later

meaning: having the energy, freshness and qualities typical of young people
